# `skillset status`

> Generated from Skillset's CLI presentation contract. See the [documentation system](../../development/documentation-system.md).

Summarize workspace health and generated drift.

## Usage

```text
skillset status [--activation] [--json] [--root <path>]
```

## Options

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--activation` | Inspect bounded provider activation evidence for status or explain. |
| `--json` | Emit exactly one versioned finite JSON result document. |
| `--root <value>` | Select the repository root; defaults to cwd or Git root according to the route. |
